candidates.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its services list restroom partitions and partition hardware. The site says it provides and installs specialty products for commercial projects, offers optional installation for all products, and describes 'installations across... partitions, doors, lockers'. One project photo shows a public restroom with metal stalls.
red_flags: Also sells and supplies partitions for pickup or delivery, so it could sell around us
The email shown is a named person's company address
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 10 supplier and installer that lists restroom partitions. It is about 84 miles from Columbus and says it serves the southeastern US.

license.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Georgia Secretary of State Professional Licensing verification (State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors), verify.sos.ga.gov
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. The Georgia license lookup returned HTTP 403 to automated access (curl and WebFetch), so no record could be read. Georgia's state status for partition installation is unclear: a general contractor license applies above $2,500, and specialty trade work may be exempt (not verified against official text). Columbus has no local rule. The company website (terminusspecialties.com) homepage shows no license number. The GA Corporations Division business search (ecorp.sos.ga.gov) also returned 403. Confirm by phone with the board or ask the installer for the license number.
